pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with relatively smooth edge gradients. Patches on the upper shoulder and lower neck are smaller and more densely clustered with sharper angularity compared to the larger, more rounded patches on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological graph. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial intersections. Pathway thickness is moderate and relatively consistent across the mid-flank region, narrowing as patch density increases at the dorsal ridge.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder, creating a finely textured 1D contour against the blurred background.

other_distinctive_markers: A localized cluster of exceptionally dark, small, and high-contrast patches is visible at the transition point between the base of the neck and the shoulder ridge.
